name: Two Shores
line: A Swiss bipartite web: 185 exposures as ticks on the left shore (red Group 1, black 2A, grey 2B), 68 cancers on the right shore grouped by organ system, all 469 links as fine curves between; scrolling re-sorts the left shore (by category, by IARC group, by number of links) with every curve following, then drops to Group 1 and ends on the lesson with the two Group 1 bundles in red.
notes: Point at (or scrub along) either shore: that entry's curves darken and the names on the far shore appear in a stacked column with leader lines; click or tap pins it and the entry card takes the place of the caption in the left column (a bottom sheet with a close button on phones), so the shores stay fully visible. Tick length grows with the number of links. Search highlights live with a keyboard listbox. Game screenshots are shown in grey until pointed at. One family only, as directed; Schibsted Grotesk has no Cyrillic, so RU would fall back to the system sans.
